cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. It is. I'd like to hand it over beside my paintings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hanging buys forgiveness. Stay to take them down and I'll stop mentioning the argument to Mum.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 conditions forgiveness, A3 specifies its delivery and A5 sets separate prices for forgiving and not telling Mum, acting as sole grantor of relational relief.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 gift objection prompts A3 venue condition; B4 work conflict/hanging offer prompts A5 labor-based tiers. Takedown timing is a proposed later duty, not proof it happens immediately after hanging.

relationship.evidence: B2 challenges transactional forgiveness and B4 offers meaningful alternative help, which A exploits.

heightening.evidence: B4 hanging offer becomes A5 forgiveness price, with further labor buying silence to Mum.

specificity.evidence: A1 opening/argument and B4 Sunday work establish exchange; A5 mother disclosure makes the additional social cost concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 two prices turns B4 helpful compromise into an expanded ledger, earned by the offered labor.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 prices B4 task and adds another relational concession for more labor.
